remaining_live_gate_order.requirement: A separately frozen and reviewed one-shot sealer must validate and seal exactly six canonical one-link regular OOF files, their hashes, PASS decision, 688 routed outer-held rows, complete model binding, and strict raw hurdle. The existing inspect-oof helper produces drafts only.

A different reviewer must bind the exact OOF seal, independently validate the MODELS.pt tensor inventory and safe CPU loading boundary, affirm routed nested-CV semantics, and preserve the ensemble diagnostic HOLD.

A reviewed materializer must consume only the four reviewed canonical fold selection receipts, apply the frozen V1R2 exact-type, vector-hash, rank-hash, fsum, division, tie, and min-H law, then write and seal one canonical receipt.

The immutable anchor must bind the reviewed OOF seal and review, V1R2 H receipt, selected H, all three value hashes, all three rank hashes, and all four source receipt hashes; a different reviewer must verify exact equality.

Only after anchor review may a fresh one-use capability bind the exact observer-fit target roles and the anchor/review without binding its future release hash; claim and consume before decode, no retry, then issue the final CPU release.

Run exactly one selected-H all-688 CPU refit under the frozen seeds, stream, epochs, and memory-safe sequential law; load no unused H banks, do no checkpoint selection or retry, record resource telemetry, seal every state/source hash, and do not compute a postfit observer-fit score.

A different reviewer must verify exact tensor keys, shapes, dtypes, C-order hashes, seeds, batch-order digest, traces, all-rank fit hash, selected-H binding, capability consumption, CPU device, and absence of target rescoring or retry.

Build the target-blind generic-parent estimator and pass all-688 host parity, selected-H online-action parity, and layerwise authoritative CPU-to-shipping parity with no rank routing, ensemble, MPS, dtype/order drift, or rounding-boundary change.

Pass exact repeat/parity and board FLOP, wall, residual, and RSS limits; independently review frozen estimator.py; construct and validate the exact two-file pinned archive; bind its SHA and every upstream gate in BANK_READY. Resource failure may open optimization only and cannot revise accuracy or H.

After BANK_READY, obtain a new one-attempt root receipt bound to the exact archive SHA, challenge, description, and direct submit argv; execute without shell reinterpretation, watch once, and seal the returned board result.
